faq.q: Do we need to fly in for the shoot?
faq.a: No. You can ship products to our studio and join the shoot over a live call, or approve shot lists and selects in your portal.

faq.q: How many assets do we get from one shoot?
faq.a: We plan the shoot around every format you need, so one shoot covers films, reels, ads and stills. The exact list is agreed before the shoot.

faq.q: Do you run the ads too?
faq.a: We can. Or we deliver creative to your media buyer or agency in the formats they need.

faq.q: Which product categories do you shoot?
faq.a: Furniture and interiors, beauty and wellness, food, footwear and product animation in 3D.
